verdict.rationale: Attio documents a public JSON REST API that apps can use to read and write workspace data, plus filtering and sorting on endpoints. Webhooks provide real-time change notifications with signed requests, and rate limiting is documented with 429 responses and a Retry-After header. Missing for 10: any evidence of upsert/assert-style endpoints, documented numeric rate-limit quotas or bulk/batch endpoints for operating at scale, cursor- or timestamp-based incremental change polling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of high-volume bidirectional sync.
